sections.Heading: Decision details
sections.Text:
You see a hand bellows.
How to use: Carry the bellows; choose an adjacent thin cloud from the pack or its cell's C menu.
Needs: a visible clear cardinal path; one transient cloud of at most 40 density.
Cost and limits: One action moves the same cloud one cell farther away, conserving its density. It can drift back. Stable clouds refuse; existing gas turns still expose creatures. A lampvein fan can thin denser clouds first.
Right now you cannot: push marsh gas (This cloud is too thick for the bellows. Wait for it to thin).

Wooden cheeks and a leather bag drive a short jet of air. Pushes one thin transient gas cloud into the next clear cell; it does not destroy the gas.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 3. Total weight: 3.
Lift Strength: 3; yours: 16.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
hand bellows cannot be thrown.
